biography: Gaetano di Mauro, a name synonymous with aggressive Brazilian motorsport, hails from the vibrant streets of Sao Paulo. His journey began not on the track, but amidst the roaring engines of his father's auto repair shop. Gaetano, captivated by the intricate dance of mechanics and speed, traded textbooks for wrenches, spending hours dissecting engines and dreaming of racing glory. A defining moment came at 16 when, using his father's modified street car, he dominated a local amateur race, leaving seasoned veterans in his dust. This victory propelled him into the world of professional stock car racing, where he quickly earned a reputation for his fearless overtaking maneuvers and unrelenting pursuit of victory. Though he faced setbacks in transitioning to international circuits, his persistence and raw talent have kept him a formidable presence in the Brazilian racing scene. Now at his peak, Gaetano is determined to cement his legacy as one of Brazil's greatest racing exports.
drivingStyle: Di Mauro's driving style is a blend of calculated aggression and raw instinct. He's known for his late-braking overtakes and his willingness to push the car to its absolute limit. Tire management is a constant battle for him, as his aggressive corner entries often lead to increased wear. Under pressure, he thrives, often finding an extra gear when the stakes are highest. While some criticize his tendency to over-drive the car, his fans adore him for his all-or-nothing approach, making him one of the most exciting drivers to watch.
